scenarioMatrix.name: Tenant and owner isolation
scenarioMatrix.usefulOutcome: Other-tenant and same-tenant other-subject cannot change or see the original row under RLS or persist a foreign-owned insert
scenarioMatrix.reasonNow: Required to distinguish entitled saves from unauthorized mutations for Task 5.
realCollaborators: PostgreSQL authenticated role and forced RLS

oracle.observation: Each foreign bearer can create and update its own distinct control file. Against the original ID without a caller-owned row, update returns 409 metadata_conflict. Both namespaces match their pre-attempt state. Full-key SQL checks under each foreign authenticated role context select/update zero original rows and reject a fresh-ID insert with foreign ownership. Vary one field at a time in SQL: tenant alone, then subject alone. Each context must first successfully insert/select/update its own row. Require an RLS-specific violation for the otherwise valid foreign insert. Use these orthogonal bearer pairs where supported and record any identity limitation.

workerRoutes.subagents: Independent reviewer and gpt-6.2-sol for evidence assembly

expectedEffects: Writes confined to isolated synthetic fixture. The save case establishes owner baseline and independent preconditions for each control. The controls case exercises all denial branches on its own fixture.
boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: Explicit operator authorization for verification including isolated fixture setup and synthetic writes. Deployment requires separate approval. Supply an explicit FILE_METADATA_TEST_DATABASE_URL and a separately approved fixture manifest identifying the allowed endpoint and database. Each case must compare the endpoint and actual connected database to the manifest and enforce the existing database suffix and write opt-in before mutations.
receipts: One named test executed per command, per-case observed outcomes, exact source and policy revisions and sanitized state comparisons.
Record intended baseline digest and actual enabled-set digest from isolated loader. Scope conclusions to that set.
cleanup: Use the approved disposable fixture lifecycle and retain redacted receipts.
stopConditions: Unexpected target, policy grant or persisted state
